description: List active alerts and their state: id, address, threshold, channel, handle (masked), last_rate (latest settle rate recorded) and fired_at (last trigger time, null if never fired). Use it to poll site-channel alerts created with flop_alert_subscribe. Reading acknowledges and clears nothing. To cancel an alert, call DELETE /api/alerts/{id} on the REST API; there is no MCP tool for it.

address.description: Only alerts for this SS58 address, plus "*" alerts. Omit for all.
